description: This is a Java test class for the MultivaluedMapContextAdapter, which verifies behavior of the adapter that wraps a MultivaluedMapContext to provide a Map-like interface. Tests include containment checks, values retrieval, and equality comparison.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContextAdapterTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for MultivaluedMapContextAdapter, testing core functionalities such as value containment, retrieval, and equality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixtures before each test, setting up a MultivaluedMapContext with sample data and its adapter.

methods.name: containsValueBasic
methods.description: Tests whether the adapter correctly reports whether it contains certain values.

methods.name: valuesBasic
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter returns the correct collection of values.

methods.name: equalityBasic
methods.description: Checks the equality comparison of the adapter against an expected HashMap.
